_doc: Permanent run exclusions. Consumers: scripts/ci/queue_pitcrew.py (drops ids from census ∧ cancel plan) ∧ scripts/que/que_feed_collect.py (drops ids from tier counts, lists them under operator_excluded, emits one `excluded` transition). Add a row only for a run the API refuses to cancel (409) ∨ a run that never reaches a runner. Rows are append-only; log every add in ops/queue/exclusions-log.jsonl.
